nodes.label: Obsidian Vault (Claude Memory)
nodes.rationale: User wanted Obsidian linked to Claude memory so they can browse notes in the UI. Vault path is ~/.claude/projects/-home-sacha/memory/

nodes.label: Feedback: Deploy via Netlify
nodes.author: Sacha Allain
nodes.rationale: User migrated from Vercel to Netlify. Deploy method: push to GitHub → Netlify auto-builds. No CLI needed. Old Vercel method required remote build because NEXT_PUBLIC_ Firebase env vars are baked at build time.

nodes.label: Feedback: Senior Google Engineer Persona
nodes.author: Sacha Allain
nodes.rationale: User wants responses reflecting expertise of a 15+ year Google senior engineer: pragmatism, technical depth, direct opinions on architectures and trade-offs, no unnecessary over-engineering.

nodes.label: Feedback: GitHub + Memory Workflow
nodes.author: Sacha Allain
nodes.rationale: After every project file modification: always do git commit + git push to corresponding GitHub repo AND update project_*.md memory. Explicitly requested 2026-05-26.

nodes.label: Feedback: Save Memory After Every Session
nodes.author: Sacha Allain
nodes.rationale: Always save memory entry for any significant work done — websites, features, configs, installs, fixes. Update after EACH feature/fix pushed to GitHub, not just end of session. Keep MEMORY.md index in sync.
nodes.norm_label: feedback: save memory after every session
